title: Vanilla EditR
description: This resource pack includes QoL features for survival, SMPs, etc. and even boosts your fps.
body:
Most important stuff this beautiful pack has:
- better glass
- no item hover overlay
- side shield
- non obstrustive fire
- sharper axes
- smaller particles
- smaller pop
- desatured netherite
- less visible pumpkin blur
- better bow texture
- animated experience & animated experience bottles
- and much more

Hope this pack gets used atleast a bit. Have a good day & take care.
